item.title: Cute pixel art dachshund under a rainbow · にじとダックスフンドのドット絵
item.description: Pixel art rainbow: rain with the sun out, a rainbow over the hills, and a dachshund looking up. From Pikomofu, a cozy virtual pet app for iPhone: cute pixel art dogs and cats living in a little garden under the real sky.
